title: Towards Better Evaluation of Instruction-Following: A Case-Study in Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by using simple length-based heuristics (word and sentence counts) as reference-free baselines to assess the degree to which collected human ratings and automated metrics disproportionately prefer longer generated summaries.

Evaluated by analyzing disagreement cases between annotators and evaluation metrics, specifically computing the percentage of times an evaluation metric prefers an output generated by a model from its own family (e.g., a PaLM metric preferring a PaLM generation).
